cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll wash up if you do two shopping trips.

mechanism: A uses professional labour estimates to price washing-up in shopping effort, then recalculates when B offers a preparation step that reduces the work.
confusable: D22 negotiates feelings and favors broadly; D46 specifically quantifies time, effort or future obligation for the exchange.
comparison: Moving alternative prices timing and stairs; pan alternative prices residue and preparation within one chore.
seedUse: Cheese pan, two trips and soaking derive from D46-a; S03 adds labour-versus-item counting and scope recalculation.
